name: lightcone-experimental
description: Opt-in, experimental skills for advanced Lightcone workflows — under active development, expect rough edges. Paper reproduction (`from-paper`), code import (`from-code`), literature substrate extraction (`paper-extraction`), autonomous iteration (`ralph`), and manuscript verification (`check-sentence-by-sentence`, `figure-comparison`). Requires the `lightcone` plugin (install it first) — these skills build on the core lc workflow, hooks, and lc-extractor subagent but do NOT bundle them. Install when you need capabilities beyond the core analysis workflow.
